$comment: Uncached `lint` task seconds per Nx task for the two `Affected (lint-<n>)` lanes of ci.yml, which deal the affected projects with scripts/src/test-shard-dealer.ts --graph. Source: the 13 successful `Affected (lint)` jobs over 400 s of 20 green merge-group runs of ci.yml, 2026-11-17 22:08Z to 2026-11-18 01:27Z, at --parallel=1; a task's seconds are the gap from the previous task header (or the step start) to its own in the job log, and each value is the median of its uncached samples. A task not listed weighs defaultSeconds, the median task. Refresh when a listed task's median moves by more than a quarter, when a project is split, or when this snapshot is older than 60 days.
